import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> G = new ArrayList<>(2020);
    static int[] level = new int[2020];
    static int[] iter = new int[2020];
    static int[][] ir = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] sc = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] pc = new int[20][20];
    static char[][] s = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] p = new char[20][20];
    static int[][] dd = new int[20][20];
    static int[] dx = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static ArrayList<Integer>[][] ns = new ArrayList[20][20];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[][] np = new ArrayList[20][20];
    static int sp, pp;
    static int S, T;
    static int n, t;

    static void add_edge(int from, int to, int cap) {
        G.get(from).add(new Edge(to, G.get(to).size(), cap));
        G.get(to).add(new Edge(from, G.get(from).size() - 1, 0));
    }

    static boolean bfs_flow() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        level[S] = 0;
        q.add(S);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : G.get(v)) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                    level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[T] >= 0;
    }

    static int dfs_flow(int v, int f) {
        if (v == T) return f;
        for (int i = iter[v]; i < G.get(v).size(); ++i) {
            Edge e = G.get(v).get(i);
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[v] < level[e.to]) {
                int d = dfs_flow(e.to, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                if (d > 0) {
                    e.cap -= d;
                    G.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += d;
                    iter[v] = i;
                    return d;
                }
            }
            iter[v] = i + 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs_flow()) {
            Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
            int f;
            while ((f = dfs_flow(S, 1000000000)) > 0)
                flow += f;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static void wk(int a, int b) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                dd[i][j] = 100000;
        Deque<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dd[a][b] = 0;
        q.addLast(new int[]{a, b});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.pollFirst();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < np[x][y].size(); ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < ns[a][b].size(); ++j)
                    add_edge(ns[a][b].get(j), np[x][y].get(i), 1);
            if (dd[x][y] == ir[x][y]) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (sc[nx][ny] != -1 && dd[nx][ny] > dd[x][y] + 1 && dd[x][y] + 1 <= ir[nx][ny]) {
                    dd[nx][ny] = dd[x][y] + 1;
                    q.addLast(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        t = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.nextLine(); // consume newline

        for (int i = 0; i < 2020; ++i)
            G.add(new ArrayList<>());

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                ir[i][j] = t;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                s[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                p[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
        }

        int rx = 0, ry = 0;
        sp = 1; pp = 1000;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (s[i][j] == 'Z' || s[i][j] == 'Y') {
                    sc[i][j] = -1;
                    ir[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (s[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    rx = i;
                    ry = j;
                    ir[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (s[i][j] >= '0' && s[i][j] <= '9')
                    sc[i][j] = s[i][j] - '0';
                ns[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int k = 0; k < sc[i][j]; ++k)
                    ns[i][j].add(sp++);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (p[i][j] >= '0' && p[i][j] <= '9')
                    pc[i][j] = p[i][j] - '0';
                np[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int k = 0; k < pc[i][j]; ++k)
                    np[i][j].add(pp++);
            }
        }

        Deque<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.addLast(new int[]{rx, ry});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.pollFirst();
            rx = cur[0]; ry = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = rx + dx[d];
                int ny = ry + dy[d];
                if (ir[nx][ny] > ir[rx][ry] + 1 && sc[nx][ny] != -1) {
                    ir[nx][ny] = ir[rx][ry] + 1;
                    q.addLast(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        S = 0; T = 2000;
        for (int i = 1; i < sp; ++i)
            add_edge(S, i, 1);
        for (int i = 1000; i < pp; ++i)
            add_edge(i, T, 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                if (sc[i][j] > 0)
                    wk(i, j);

        System.out.println(max_flow());
    }
}
